info.title: 한줄 개인 메모 API
info.description: Single-owner notes API. Bearer read scope allows GET; write scope permits note mutations. Token administration/export/import require owner cookie. Cookie mutations require CSRF. Sensitive owner actions require verification within 5 minutes; 428 code REAUTH_REQUIRED prompts password or passkey verification. Remembered sessions last 30 days from login, otherwise 12 hours with session cookie.
